name: Native Village of Kivalina v. ExxonMobil Corp.
summary: The Ninth Circuit held that an Alaskan native village's federal common law nuisance claim against fossil fuel companies for climate-related flooding was displaced by the Clean Air Act.
significance: A federal appeals court dismissed a climate nuisance lawsuit brought by an Alaska village, finding federal common law claims were displaced by the Clean Air Act, illustrating the trajectory of federal preemption arguments in climate litigation.
